paper.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors

result.summary: 这篇论文研究的是在小型训练集上训练大型前馈神经网络时出现的过拟合问题，并提出用随机“dropout”方法在每次训练样本呈现时以0.5的概率随机省略一半特征检测器来缓解该问题 [p1][p3]。作者认为dropout可以阻止特征检测器之间复杂的共适应，使每个神经元学习在多种内部上下文中都普遍有用的特征 [p1][p3]。实验表明dropout在多个基准任务上带来大幅改进，并在语音和物体识别上创下新纪录 [p1]。作者还通过特征可视化验证dropout迫使判别模型学习更简单、更少共适应的特征，从而带来更好的泛化 [A1.SS3.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多的隐藏单元来精确建模，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其是当标注训练数据有限时 [p2]。这些权重向量在留出测试数据上会做出不同预测，且几乎都会比在训练数据上表现更差，因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作而非在测试数据上 [p2]。

evidence.quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.

If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.

Each of these weight vectors will make different predictions on held-out test data and almost all of them will do worse on the test data than on the training data because the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.

method.text: 论文提出用“dropout”来防止训练数据上的复杂共适应：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以0.5的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。dropout也可以被看作一种非常高效的神经网络模型平均方式，它使得在合理时间内训练大量不同网络成为可能，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。作者还将dropout视为bagging的极端形式，其中每个模型在单个样本上训练，且每个参数通过与其他所有模型中的对应参数共享而受到非常强的正则化 [p16]。

evidence.quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
Another way to view the dropout procedure is as a very efficient way of performing model averaging with neural networks.
Random dropout makes it possible to train a huge number of different networks in a reasonable time.

Dropout can be seen as an extreme form of bagging in which each model is trained on a single case and each parameter of the model is very strongly regularized by sharing it with the corresponding parameter in all the other models.

experiments.text: 论文在MNIST数据集上进行了实验，该数据集包含28×28的数字图像，其中60,000张用于训练、10,000张用于测试，目标是将数字图像分类到正确的数字类别 [A1.SS1.p1]。作者测试了不同架构的神经网络（不同隐藏单元数和层数），包括784-800-800-10、784-1200-1200-10、784-2000-2000-10和784-1200-1200-1200-10四种网络，对所有隐藏单元使用50%的dropout率、对可见单元使用20%的dropout率 [A1.SS1.p1]。训练使用随机梯度下降，minibatch大小为100，目标函数为交叉熵，学习率从10.0开始每轮乘以0.998，训练进行3000轮 [A1.SS1.p1]。此外，论文还在Reuters数据集上进行了实验，展示了2000-2000-1000-50和2000-1000-1000-50两种架构在有和无dropout下的训练和测试集误差 [A3.p4]。论文还针对CIFAR-10和ImageNet使用了深度前馈卷积神经网络（CNN）模型 [A6.p1]。

evidence.quote: The MNIST dataset consists of 28 $\times$ 28 digit images - 60,000 for training and 10,000 for testing.
For each of these architectures we use the same dropout rates - 50% dropout for all hidden units and 20% dropout for visible units.
We use stochastic gradient descent with 100-sized minibatches and a cross-entropy objective function.
The learning rate is multiplied by 0.998 after each epoch of training.
Training was done for 3000 epochs.
We show two nets - one with a 2000-2000-1000-50 and another with a 2000-1000-1000-50 architecture trained with and without dropout.
Our models for CIFAR-10 and ImageNet are deep, feed-forward convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

findings.text: 随机dropout在许多基准任务上带来大幅改进，并在语音和物体识别上创下新纪录 [p1]。在Reuters数据集上，与之前讨论的所有数据集一样，dropout也带来了显著改进，学习不仅带来更好的泛化，而且进展平滑，无需早停 [A3.p4]。通过查看784-500-500神经网络学习的第一层特征，发现dropout学到的特征更简单、看起来像笔画，而标准反向传播学到的特征难以解释，这证实dropout确实迫使判别模型学习更少共适应的好特征，从而带来更好的泛化 [A1.SS3.p1]。在ImageNet上，使用非卷积的高层且参数很多时，dropout带来大幅改进，而不用dropout则使情况变糟 [A8.p3]。

evidence.quote: Random “dropout” gives big improvements on many benchmark tasks and sets new records for speech and object recognition.
As in all previous datasets discussed so far, we obtain significant improvements here too.
The learning not only results in better generalization, but also proceeds smoothly, without the need for early stopping.
The features that dropout learns are simpler and look like strokes, whereas the ones learned by standard backpropagation are difficult to interpret.
This confirms that dropout indeed forces the discriminative model to learn good features which are less co-adapted and leads to better generalization.
This is clearly demonstrated by the fact that using non-convolutional higher layers with a lot of parameters leads to a big improvement with dropout but makes things worse without dropout.

limitations.text: 原文指出，卷积共享滤波器架构的一个后果是相对于所有神经元使用不同滤波器的神经网络大幅减少了参数数量，这降低了网络的表示能力，但也降低了过拟合的能力，因此dropout在卷积层中远没有那么有优势 [A6.p3]。

evidence.quote: This reduces the net’s representational capacity, but it also reduces its capacity to overfit, so dropout is far less advantageous in convolutional layers.
